description: This file is a shell script that manages the syslog service, including starting, stopping, and configuring syslog logging behavior on a system. It handles log levels, remote logging configurations, and service control logic.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the syslog service, configuring log levels and forwarding logs.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the syslog service and cleans up linked files.

methods.name: service_init
methods.description: Initializes service parameters by retrieving configuration values.
